audit.why: Both layers already read Volibear, Volibear, Volibear, Volibear, Skill, Locke, Skill and that matches the packet chart exactly; the why-strings agree with their rows. No mirror audit exists yet (locke__volibear absent), so nothing to reconcile.

Spikes are already specific and match the kit: his level-6 execute (R, 120/100/80s), his first AP item, and Volibear's levels 1-3 bully window. Volibear's Stormbringer is correctly used as a dive rather than a shield.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page's only real interaction gap is on his W: report[8].t tells the reader anti-heal is optional because 'his sustain is self-refund, not lifesteal'. Riot's text says the ability heals him back a portion of the damage taken during the effect — a heal is a heal, and Grievous Wounds applies. phases[1].why also described his E without its cooldown even though the flat 10s is the entire punish window.
audit.why: Telling a Volibear to skip Grievous Wounds against a champion whose W refunds damage costs him the HP race he is otherwise built to win.
audit.corrected: Grievous Wounds does cut his W's end-of-duration heal; his E is a flat 10s and is both his engage and his only exit.

audit.why: His R carries a 'grounding' derived flag (shuts off enemy dashes), which would matter enormously for Stormbringer, but Riot's description says only that it damages, potentially executes, and empowers him for sealing champions. Flag contradicts the text, so no grounding claim was written.
audit.corrected: No 'his R grounds your leap' advice added.
sources: enemyKit R text vs derived flags

edits.before: His E is online but it’s also his only exit — any trade he takes is a one-way door you get to close.
edits.after: His E is a flat 10s and his only exit — any trade he starts is a one-way door you get to close on him.

edits.before: Early HP and MR blunt the nail chip (his damage is AP). A stopwatch/Zhonya’s-class answer beats Purgatory outright: untargetable at the floor = execute denied. Anti-heal is optional — his sustain is self-refund, not lifesteal.
edits.after: Early HP and MR blunt the nail chip (his damage is AP). A stopwatch/Zhonya’s-class answer beats Purgatory outright: untargetable at the floor = execute denied. Grievous Wounds does cut his W's end-of-duration heal — bring it if he out-lasts you.

edits.before: Locke wastes Ritual Nails — that is your full-commit window.
edits.after: Break off above the execute floor, not when you reach it.

edits.before: Your sustain and Relentless Storm empowered autos out-trade him at 2.
edits.after: Your sustain and The Relentless Storm autos out-trade him at 2.

notes: All four of the packet's suspect names are FALSE POSITIVES caused by possessive forms: "Thundering Smash's", "Frenzied Maul's" and "Sky Splitter's" are the real Volibear abilities, and "Relentless Storm" was only missing the leading "The" (fixed). UNVERIFIED, flagged rather than changed: the page calls Locke's Q "Ritual Nails" and his E "Ashen Pursuit", but the kit file gives no display names for Locke and Riot's Q text refers to the projectiles as "Soul Nails" — I have no source that settles which is the ability's real name, so I left every occurrence alone rather than risk renaming a correct ability across a dozen strings. Same for "Soul Ignition" (his W) and "Purgatory" (his R). Also unverified: the repeated "125 range" figure for his autos — the kit lists no attack range. His R carries a grounding derived flag that his description does not support; if that flag is real it would deny Stormbringer's leap and would be the single most important line on this page — worth a human check.
